checklist: Your one-time account on rrbapply.gov.in — the form needs it before anything else
Signature scan ready: JPG, 30-49 KB, at least 140 x 60 px, running handwriting
Aadhaar and Class 10 certificate side by side — the name and date of birth must match 100%
For the live photo: a plain, light-coloured wall and light falling on your face
Copies of the final files, kept safe with your application number
documents: Signature — JPG, 30-49 KB, minimum 140 x 60 px
Passport-style photo, 35 x 45 mm, JPG, roughly 20-50 KB — standby only, if your category offers an upload option; the form itself captures the photo live
donts: No cap or sunglasses for the live photo
Do not reuse a bank or SSC signature file — their 10-20 KB band fails here
Do not sign in BLOCK CAPITAL letters
Do not let the signature slip below 30 KB — it is rejected just as firmly
Do not depend on an old studio photo file — the 2026 form captures the photo live
dos: Sit facing a plain, light-coloured wall, with the light on your face — not behind you
Keep the camera at eye level so your full face is visible and sharp
Sign in running handwriting with a black or blue pen on plain white paper
Photograph just the signature, cropped tight
Aim for about 40 KB — the middle of the 30-49 KB band
eligibility: Graduation in any stream — this CEN is for graduate-level NTPC posts.

Four graduate posts, 3,548 in all (provisional): Goods Train Manager 2,750 (Pay Level 5), Senior Clerk cum Typist 371 (Level 5), Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist 300 (Level 5) and Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor 127 (Level 6).
Age 18-33 years as on 1 January 2027 (relaxation for reserved categories as per the notice).

extra_faq.a: No. The Railway band for NTPC is 30-49 KB — a file below 30 KB is rejected too. Compress or re-scan to a target of about 40 KB, the safe middle of the band.
extra_faq.q: My signature file is only 20 KB. Will it be accepted?

extra_faq.a: Graduates apply under CEN 06/2026 (last date 8 November 2026, extended by Corrigendum-1). If you are 12th (10+2) pass, your CEN is 07/2026 (last date 13 November 2026).
extra_faq.q: Which NTPC CEN should I apply to — 06/2026 or 07/2026?

extra_faq.a: Yes. Sign in the same running-hand style you will use in the exam hall — a mismatch can cause trouble at document verification.
extra_faq.q: Should the signature match the one I use in the exam hall?

fees: Application fee: ₹500 for most candidates — ₹400 of it is refunded (less bank charges) when you appear in CBT 1.
₹250 for SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, PwBD, Female, Transgender, Minorities and EBC candidates — refunded in full (less bank charges) when you appear in CBT 1.
Correction window: 9-18 November 2026 — each change costs a non-refundable ₹250.

checklist: rrbapply.gov.in पर आपका one-time account — फॉर्म से पहले यही चाहिए
हस्ताक्षर का scan तैयार: JPG, 30-49 KB, कम से कम 140 x 60 px, चलती लिखावट
Aadhaar और Class 10 certificate साथ रखो — नाम और जन्मतिथि 100% मिलने चाहिए
Live फोटो के लिए: सादी, हल्के रंग की दीवार और चेहरे पर पड़ती रोशनी
तैयार फाइलों की copy, अपनी application संख्या के साथ संभाल कर रखो
documents: हस्ताक्षर — JPG, 30-49 KB, कम से कम 140 x 60 px
Passport-style फोटो, 35 x 45 mm, JPG, करीब 20-50 KB — सिर्फ standby, अगर आपकी category में upload का विकल्प मिले; फॉर्म खुद फोटो live लेता है
donts: Live फोटो के लिए टोपी या धूप का चश्मा नहीं

BLOCK CAPITAL अक्षरों में हस्ताक्षर मत करो
हस्ताक्षर 30 KB से नीचे न जाने दो — वह भी उतनी ही पक्की तरह reject होता है
पुरानी studio फोटो फाइल के भरोसे मत रहो — 2026 के फॉर्म में फोटो live लिया जाता है
dos: सादी, हल्के रंग की दीवार के सामने बैठो, रोशनी चेहरे पर पड़े — पीछे से नहीं
कैमरा आंखों के बराबर रखो ताकि पूरा चेहरा साफ़ और तेज़ दिखे
सादे सफेद कागज़ पर काले या नीले पेन से चलती लिखावट में हस्ताक्षर करो
सिर्फ हस्ताक्षर की फोटो लो, आसपास की जगह काटकर
करीब 40 KB का target रखो — 30-49 KB band के ठीक बीच में
eligibility: किसी भी stream में graduation — यह CEN स्नातक-स्तर के NTPC पदों के लिए है।

चार स्नातक पद, कुल 3,548 (provisional): Goods Train Manager 2,750 (Pay Level 5), Senior Clerk cum Typist 371 (Level 5), Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist 300 (Level 5) और Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor 127 (Level 6)।
उम्र 1 जनवरी 2027 को 18-33 वर्ष (आरक्षित श्रेणियों को notice के अनुसार छूट)।

extra_faq.a: स्नातक CEN 06/2026 में आवेदन करें (अंतिम तिथि 8 नवंबर 2026, Corrigendum-1 से बढ़ाई गई)। अगर आप 12वीं (10+2) पास हैं तो आपका CEN 07/2026 है (अंतिम तिथि 13 नवंबर 2026)।
extra_faq.q: किस NTPC CEN में आवेदन करूँ — 06/2026 या 07/2026?

kit.title: हस्ताक्षर — target 40 KB रखो

kit.text: अगर आपकी category में फोटो upload का option मिले तो passport-style फोटो यहाँ resize करो। मुख्य फॉर्म में live camera फोटो ही लगता है।
kit.title: फोटो resize (standby)

kit.title: Document PDF — छोटा करो

eligibility: Chief Law Assistant (17 posts) — Law degree with 3 years' standing practice as a Pleader at the Bar. Age 18–40. Pay Level 7, ₹44,900. Medical C-1. (Serving Railway law graduates with 5 years' service and Railway Magistrates can also apply.)
Public Prosecutor (21) — Bachelor's degree in Law with 5 years' standing as an advocate at the Bar. Age 18–32. Level 7, ₹44,900. Medical C-1.

Senior Publicity Inspector (8) — Degree plus Diploma in Public Relations, Advertising, Journalism or Mass Communication; 2 years' related experience desirable. Age 18–33. Level 6, ₹35,400. Medical C-1.

Junior Translator/Hindi (79) — Master's degree in Hindi or English, with the other language as a subject or medium at degree level, plus a recognised Hindi–English translation diploma/certificate or 2 years' translation experience. Age 18–33. Level 6, ₹35,400. Medical C-2.

Staff and Welfare Inspector (27) — Graduation plus any one of: Diploma in Labour/Social Welfare, Diploma in Labour Laws, LLB with Labour Law papers, PG Diploma in Personnel Management, MBA with Personnel Management, MBA/HR, or PG Diploma in HRM. Age 18–33. Level 6, ₹35,400. Medical C-1.
Scientific Assistant (Training) (3) — Master's degree in Psychology with 50% marks. Age 18–35. Level 6, ₹35,400. Medical B-1.
Lab Assistant Grade III, Chemist & Metallurgist (36) — 12th pass with Physics and Chemistry. Age 18–30. Level 2, ₹19,900. Medical B-1.

eligibility: 5,431 posts in all: FDA 2,726 (RPC 2,163 + Kalyana-Karnataka 563) and SDA 2,705 (RPC 2,070 + Kalyana-Karnataka 635), plus allied posts like Accounts Assistant, Warden, Hostel Supervisor and computer-operator posts.

FDA posts need a Bachelor's degree; SDA posts need 2nd PUC (12th pass) or a diploma, post-wise. The qualification must be held on or before 25 November 2026 — candidates awaiting results are not eligible.

Age (as on 25 November 2026): minimum 18; maximum 40 for General Merit, 43 for Cat-2A/2B/3A/3B, 45 for SC/ST/Cat-1 — these maximums already include a one-time 5-year relaxation. PwD candidates, widows and ex-servicemen get further relaxation as per the notice.
A compulsory Kannada Language Test (150 marks, minimum 50 to pass) applies unless you are exempt — for example, if you studied Kannada as a first or second language up to SSLC or higher.

Selection: offline OMR competitive exam — Paper-1 General Knowledge (100 marks) and Paper-2 General Kannada, General English & Computer Knowledge (100 marks); a minimum of 35% is compulsory; −0.25 for every wrong answer, and also for a question left with no circle shaded.

eligibility: 2,423 posts in 15 subjects (post codes 26046–26060): English 187, Mathematics 281, Hindi 187, Political Science 156, History 156, Economics 156, plus Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Sanskrit, Computer, Music, Commerce, Physical Education and Fine Arts. The total is the sum of the subject-wise figures in the notice and is tentative.

Most subjects need a Master's degree in the subject (50%) with B.Ed (50%) and TET passed; English and Mathematics follow their own pattern (55% in the subject at graduation). All qualifications must be held by 5 December 2026.
Age: 18–45 years as on 1 January 2026. The notice prints this as a single limit for everyone — it does not list category-wise age relaxation.
One Time Registration (OTR) on the HPRCA portal is compulsory before the online application, and you must be able to teach in Hindi and English.

Selection: a single Computer Based Test / written screening test — 120 MCQ, 120 marks, 1½ hours. Qualifying marks: 45% for General category and 40% for SC/ST/OBC/Wards of Freedom Fighters. The notice prescribes no negative marking.

extra_faq.a: No. All 15 posts are scheme-based temporary engagements for five years at a fixed ₹30,000 per month (payable for 10 months in an academic year). The notice says there is no right to regularisation and the teachers are not deemed government employees in any manner.
extra_faq.q: Are these regular government teacher posts?

extra_faq.a: No. Every candidate pays ₹100 examination fee + ₹700 processing fee = ₹800, and reserved-category candidates of other states are treated as General. The fee is not refunded.
extra_faq.q: Is there any fee concession for SC/ST or women candidates?

extra_faq.a: Yes — the notice opens a correction window for four days, starting three days after the closing date, at a fee of ₹100. On that wording it falls around 8–11 December 2026; the exact dates will show on the portal. Category cannot be changed after the window closes.
extra_faq.q: Can I correct the application after submitting?

fees: Examination fee ₹100 + processing fee ₹700 = ₹800 for every candidate — there is no category exemption.
Correction, when the window opens, costs ₹100. The fee once paid is neither refunded nor held for another examination.

eligibility: 15 विषयों में 2,423 पद (post code 26046–26060): अंग्रेज़ी 187, गणित 281, हिंदी 187, राजनीति विज्ञान 156, इतिहास 156, अर्थशास्त्र 156, साथ में भौतिकी, रसायन, जीव विज्ञान, संस्कृत, कंप्यूटर, संगीत, वाणिज्य, शारीरिक शिक्षा और ललित कला। यह कुल संख्या notice के विषय-वार आँकड़ों का योग है और अस्थायी है।

अधिकतर विषयों के लिए विषय में स्नातकोत्तर (50%) के साथ बी.एड (50%) और TET उत्तीर्ण चाहिए; अंग्रेज़ी और गणित का अपना pattern है (स्नातक में विषय में 55%)। सभी योग्यताएँ 5 दिसंबर 2026 तक प्राप्त होनी चाहिए।
उम्र: 1 जनवरी 2026 को 18–45 वर्ष। Notice में यह सीमा सभी के लिए एक ही छपी है — श्रेणी-वार आयु छूट की सूची नहीं दी गई है।
HPRCA portal पर One Time Registration (OTR) online आवेदन से पहले अनिवार्य है, और हिंदी व अंग्रेज़ी दोनों में पढ़ाने की क्षमता चाहिए।

चयन: एकल Computer Based Test / लिखित screening test — 120 MCQ, 120 अंक, 1½ घंटे। अर्हता अंक: सामान्य श्रेणी 45%, SC/ST/OBC/स्वतंत्रता सेनानी आश्रित 40%। Notice में negative marking का प्रावधान नहीं है।

extra_faq.a: नहीं। सभी 15 पद योजना-आधारित अस्थायी नियुक्तियाँ हैं — पाँच साल के लिए, निश्चित ₹30,000 प्रति माह (एक शैक्षणिक वर्ष में 10 माह का भुगतान)। Notice कहता है कि नियमितीकरण का कोई अधिकार नहीं है और ये शिक्षक किसी भी रूप में सरकारी कर्मचारी नहीं माने जाएँगे।
extra_faq.q: क्या ये नियमित सरकारी शिक्षक पद हैं?

extra_faq.a: नहीं। हर उम्मीदवार ₹100 परीक्षा शुल्क + ₹700 processing शुल्क = ₹800 भरता है, और अन्य राज्यों के आरक्षित-श्रेणी उम्मीदवार सामान्य माने जाते हैं। शुल्क वापस नहीं होता।
extra_faq.q: क्या SC/ST या महिला उम्मीदवारों को शुल्क में छूट है?

extra_faq.a: हाँ — notice के अनुसार अंतिम तिथि के तीन दिन बाद से चार दिन के लिए correction window खुलती है, शुल्क ₹100। उस हिसाब से यह लगभग 8–11 दिसंबर 2026 पड़ेगी; सटीक तारीखें portal पर दिखेंगी। Window बंद होने के बाद श्रेणी नहीं बदलेगी।
extra_faq.q: क्या submit के बाद आवेदन में सुधार हो सकता है?

fees: परीक्षा शुल्क ₹100 + processing शुल्क ₹700 = हर उम्मीदवार के लिए ₹800 — किसी श्रेणी को छूट नहीं है।
Correction window खुलने पर सुधार का शुल्क ₹100 है। भरा हुआ शुल्क न वापस होता है, न किसी अन्य परीक्षा के लिए रखा जाता है।

JE: a Degree in Electrical Engineering, or a Diploma in Electrical Engineering with 2 years' professional experience (with department-wise variations in the notice). MTS: Matriculation (10th pass).

specs: Photo: a recent, clear colour photograph — plain white or off-white background, full face, front view, eyes open. The advertisement fixes no KB or pixel size for the photo or the signature.

Signature: keep it clear and legible — a blurred or illegible photo/signature is a stated reason for rejection. Supporting documents are NOT uploaded with the application; they are called later through the e-dossier.

For the OARS registration's photo-identity proof (only if you scan one instead of using Aadhaar): JPG/JPEG, each file 15 KB to 60 KB — minimum resolution 300 x 200 px for PAN/Driving Licence, 200 x 300 px for Voter Card, 450 x 350 px for Passport.

eligibility: 1,237 posts: Group-A 243 (Assistant Tribal Development Officer 50, Social Welfare Inspector 89, Senior Clerk 51, Sub Registrar Grade-1 6 and Grade-2 15, Office Assistant 15, Head Clerk 10, Office Superintendent 7) and Group-B 994 (Junior Clerk).
A Bachelor's degree is required for both groups, with basic computer knowledge and adequate knowledge of Gujarati and/or Hindi.
Age: 20–35 years as on 30 November 2026, with the relaxations printed in the notice (up to a maximum of 45 years for some categories).

Selection: Preliminary MCQ examination (150 questions, 150 marks, 120 minutes, −0.25 per wrong answer; screening only), then the Mains — Group-A descriptive papers totalling 350 marks, Group-B a single MCQ paper of 200 marks. You must score at least 40% in every stage and every paper; this standard cannot be lowered for any category.

Pay is a fixed monthly amount for the first five years — ₹49,600 for Sub Registrar Grade-1, Office Superintendent and Assistant Tribal Development Officer; ₹40,800 for Sub Registrar Grade-2, Social Welfare Inspector and Head Clerk; ₹26,000 for Senior Clerk, Office Assistant and Junior Clerk — and the regular pay scale after that.

Madhyamik (10th) plus a 3-year Diploma in Survey Engineering — OR Madhyamik plus a 2-year ITI Surveyor certificate course with 1 year's experience in Survey & Settlement work, as the notice describes.

eligibility: 501 vacancies (495 General + 6 Special recruitment): Review Officer 131 and RO (Account) 31, Assistant Review Officer 329 and ARO (Account) 6, plus Manager, Care-Taker, Receptionist (Swagati) and Store Keeper (1 each, in UPPSC).

RO/ARO (Secretariat, Board of Revenue, Advocate General offices): Bachelor's degree, an 'O' Level certificate (DOEACC/NIELIT) or equivalent, and Hindi typing of at least 25 wpm — English typing is preferred. UPPSC-office RO/ARO posts also accept a Computer Science diploma in place of 'O' Level; accountant posts need B.Com with Accountancy and 'O' Level in Computer Application.
One Time Registration (OTR) on otr.pariksha.nic.in is compulsory, and it must be at least 72 hours old before you start the application.
Age: 21–40 years as on 1 July 2026 (born 2 July 1986 to 1 July 2005), with the relaxations printed in the notice. Date of birth is accepted only as recorded in the High School certificate.

Selection: Prelims (General Studies 140 + General Hindi 60 = 200 questions, 200 marks, 3 hours, negative marking of one-third) and then the Mains (four written papers of 200 marks each). There is no interview; merit is on the Mains alone. The minimum efficiency standard is 40% (35% for SC/ST of UP) in both stages.

extra_faq.a: The One Time Registration on otr.pariksha.nic.in gives you a permanent registration number for all UPPSC exams. The advertisement requires the OTR number to be obtained at least 72 hours before you start the application — without it, the application cannot be completed. Your photo and signature are also taken from the OTR profile.

fees: Prelims fee (exam fee + ₹25 online processing fee): UR / EWS / OBC ₹125; SC / ST ₹65; PwD ₹25; Ex-servicemen ₹65. Dependents of Freedom Fighters, women and skilled players pay by their original category.
Candidates who qualify for the Mains pay a second, separate fee — UR/EWS/OBC ₹225, SC/ST of UP ₹105, PwD ₹25. Payment is through SBI MOPS.

चयन: प्रारंभिक परीक्षा (सामान्य अध्ययन 140 + सामान्य हिंदी 60 = 200 सवाल, 200 अंक, 3 घंटे, एक-तिहाई negative marking) और फिर मुख्य परीक्षा (चार लिखित पेपर, हर एक 200 अंक)। कोई साक्षात्कार नहीं; merit सिर्फ़ मुख्य परीक्षा पर। न्यूनतम दक्षता मानक दोनों चरणों में 40% (यूपी के SC/ST के लिए 35%) है।

en.name: ONGC Apprentice
en.tagline: 3,047 apprentice seats across 24 work centres — apply free on the NAPS/NATS portal by 20 November 2026.
fees: No application fee is mentioned in the advertisement — applications are made only through the NAPS portal (ITI/trade seats) or the NATS portal (diploma/graduate seats).
eligibility: Age 18–24 years as on 29 November 2026 (born between 29 November 2002 and 29 November 2008). Relaxation: SC/ST +5 years, OBC (NCL) +3 years, PwBD +10 to 15 years as per rules.

Qualification is trade-wise: 10th pass for trades like Library Assistant; ITI in the relevant trade for COPA, Electrician, Fitter and similar trades; 12th or ITI for Fire Safety Technician; B.Sc (Chemistry) for Lab Chemist; BBA for Executive (HR); any graduate for Secretarial Assistant; a 3-year Diploma or Degree for the diploma/graduate executive trades; a Geology degree for Petroleum Executive.
You must not have completed 3 years since passing the qualifying examination, and the district-of-residence rules in the advertisement decide which work centre you can choose.
Selection is on the merit of qualifying-examination marks, followed by document verification — there is no written test. The advertisement gives 15 December 2026 as the result/selection date.
Stipend during the 12-month training: Graduate apprentice ₹12,300/month, 3-year Diploma ₹10,900, 2-year ITI ₹10,560, 1-year ITI ₹9,600, Trade apprentice (10th/12th) ₹8,200.
specs: The advertisement does not print a fixed KB size for the photo and signature — upload them in the format and size the portal asks for on the upload screen.
Keep a recent colour photograph and a clear signature scan (signed on white paper) ready before you start.
Upload only clear, readable scans; a blurred photo or signature can get the form rejected.
dos: Register on the correct portal — NAPS for ITI/trade seats, NATS for diploma/graduate seats.
Choose the trade and work centre your district and qualification actually allow.
Keep your NAPS/NATS registration number safe; it is needed throughout.
Apply well before 20 November — there is no fee window or correction window after it.
Keep the qualifying-exam marksheet ready; selection is purely on its marks.
donts: Do not treat this as a permanent ONGC job — it is 12-month apprenticeship training.
Do not pay anyone for this application — the advertisement charges no fee.
Do not apply if 3 years have already passed since your qualifying exam.
Do not apply for a trade your qualification does not match.
Do not wait for a correction window — the advertisement announces none.

mistakes: Registering on the wrong portal — ITI candidates on NATS or graduates on NAPS — so the ONGC application never links.

steps: Read Advt ONGC/APPR/1/2026 on ongcindia.com and note your trade's qualification and work centres.
Register on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in (NAPS) for ITI/trade seats, or nats.education.gov.in (NATS) for diploma/graduate seats.
Complete your portal profile and note the registration number.
Apply for the ONGC apprentice engagement (Advt ONGC/APPR/1/2026) in your trade and work centre.
Upload the documents and submit before 20 November 2026.
Save the submitted application and watch for the selection list around 15 December 2026.

extra_faq.q: Is the ONGC apprentice a permanent job?
extra_faq.a: No. It is 12 months of apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961 with a monthly stipend. The advertisement does not promise a regular ONGC post after training.

extra_faq.q: Is there any application fee or written exam?
extra_faq.a: No fee is mentioned in the advertisement, and there is no written test — selection is on the merit of your qualifying-examination marks, followed by document verification.

fees: Vigyapan me koi application fee nahi di gayi hai — application sirf NAPS portal (ITI/trade seats) ya NATS portal (diploma/graduate seats) se hoti hai.

Yogyata trade ke hisaab se hai: Library Assistant jaise trades ke liye 10th pass; COPA, Electrician, Fitter jaise trades ke liye sambandhit trade me ITI; Fire Safety Technician ke liye 12th ya ITI; Lab Chemist ke liye B.Sc (Chemistry); Executive (HR) ke liye BBA; Secretarial Assistant ke liye koi bhi graduate; diploma/graduate executive trades ke liye 3-saala Diploma ya Degree; Petroleum Executive ke liye Geology ki degree.

en.tagline: 1,397 fresher posts — 343 Probationary Officers and 1,054 Banking Associates for the J&K and Ladakh UTs — last date 26 November 2026.
fees: Probationary Officer: ₹1,200 (SC/ST/SEBC/PwBD: ₹1,000), plus GST.
Banking Associate: ₹800 (SC/ST/SEBC/PwBD/ESM: ₹600), plus GST.
The fee is paid online during the application and is not refunded.
eligibility: Posts: for the J&K UT — Banking Associate 1,033 and Probationary Officer 323; for the Ladakh UT — Banking Associate 21 and Probationary Officer 20. There are separate notifications for each UT and each post — apply on the notification of your own UT.
Domicile of the respective Union Territory (J&K or Ladakh) is compulsory. After selection, a minimum of 5 years' service in the allotted zone applies.
Education: graduation in any discipline from a recognised university.
Age 20–30 years as on 1 January 2026. Relaxation: SC/ST +5 years, SEBC +3 years in J&K (+5 years in Ladakh), PwBD +10 years.

Selection is conducted through IBPS. Banking Associate: a single online exam of 100 questions / 100 marks in 60 minutes, with −0.25 per wrong answer. Probationary Officer: Prelims, then Mains (170 questions / 200 marks plus a 25-mark descriptive paper), then an Interview of 100 marks — final merit is Mains 80 : Interview 20.

Pay: PO starts at a basic of ₹48,480 (JMGS-I scale ₹48,480–85,920); Banking Associate starts at a basic of ₹24,050 (scale ₹24,050–64,480). Probation: PO 2 years (bond ₹2 lakh), Banking Associate 6 months (bond ₹1 lakh).
specs: Photograph: recent colour photo, 4.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 200 × 230 pixels, JPG, 20–50 KB.
Live photograph: a live photo is also captured during the application — fill the form yourself, in good light, so the live capture matches your uploaded photo.
Signature: sign with black ink on white paper — NOT in capital letters — and scan at 140 × 60 pixels, JPG, 10–20 KB.
Left thumb impression: on white paper, scanned at 240 × 240 pixels at 200 DPI, JPG, 20–50 KB.
Hand-written declaration: write the declaration text in your own handwriting in English (not in capitals), scan at 800 × 400 pixels at 200 DPI, JPG, 50–100 KB.
Other documents: PDF files of up to 500 KB each; scan documents at a minimum of 200 DPI.
dos: Apply on the notification of your own UT — J&K and Ladakh have separate notifications and separate post counts.
Keep all five uploads ready in exact size: photo, live photo, signature, thumb impression and hand-written declaration.
Write the declaration by hand in your own handwriting — a typed declaration is rejected.
Check your domicile certificate before applying; without UT domicile the form is not valid.
Fill the form in good light so the live photograph capture is clear.
donts: Do not sign in CAPITAL letters — such signatures are rejected.
Do not apply if you are not a domicile of J&K or Ladakh UT.
Do not upload someone else's photo or a selfie in place of the scanned photo.
Do not miss that the PO and Banking Associate have different fees and different exams.
Do not leave the form for 26 November evening — fee payment closes with the application.

steps: Open rrcnr.org and read Notification RRC/NR/03/2026/Act Apprentice fully.
Register with your name, father's name, community/category, mobile number, email ID and date of birth — the password arrives by email and SMS.
Log in to the candidate dashboard and fill the application form; choose your cluster, unit and trade carefully.
Pay the ₹100 fee online if applicable (SC/ST/PwBD/Women pay nothing).
Upload the photo, signature and left thumb impression (each JPG, 10-50 KB) and the certificates.
Submit by 11 December 2026, 11:59 PM and save or print the application and fee payment slip.
